subject: Onramp demo — coordinating a four-way initial call
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@aurelia-sys.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, procurement@aurelia-sys.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onramp demo — coordinating a four-way initial call

Hi Liam —

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. Per our conversation, we'd like to run a short 45-minute onramp/demo to cover:

- High-level product fit for your use cases (search & assist flows)
- Security/PHI handling and audit logs overview (Soojin will cover)
- Integration touchpoints and implementation timeline (Dev will cover)
- Procurement/contract cadence (cc'ed)

Proposed windows (PT):
- Wed Jun 16 — 10:00–10:45 OR 14:00–14:45
- Thu Jun 17 — 09:30–10:15 OR 15:30–16:15

If none of those work, send two slots that do and we'll lock it. I've attached a short demo prep checklist and the SOC2 evidence request template so your team can pre-seed questions.

Quick ask: can you confirm who from engineering will attend (name + role)? We want to make sure we bring the right engineer for the integration discussion.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai | M: (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-demo-prep-checklist.pdf (1 page), SOC2-evidence-reqs.xlsx (stub)
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@aurelia-sys.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@aurelia-sys.com>, procurement@aurelia-sys.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onramp demo — coordinating a four-way initial call

Evelyn —

Thanks for the note and the docs.

Priya (engineering lead) and I looked at the windows. Thu Jun 17 15:30–16:15 PT looks best for the product + security walkthrough. Priya will join as the engineering lead; procurement asked to be looped in for the contracting flow.

One ask before we lock: Priya wants to validate whether Redwood can pre-send a short list of sample APIs/endpoints you plan to demo (so her team can scope inbound firewall rules). If possible, include any port/host details or self-hosted requirements in the SOC2 template.

I'll tentatively hold the Thu slot and wait for confirmation from your side.

—Liam
Liam O'Connor | Product Champion, Aurelia Systems
liam.oconnor@aurelia-sys.com | +1 617-555-0143

Thanks Liam — Dev here (SE).

Thu Jun 17 15:30–16:15 PT works for us. We'll bring the engineers who own the runtime integration and the SDK/connector flow. For Priya's firewall question:

- We typically demo against our hosted API endpoints (api.redwood.inference) over HTTPS (443). No inbound ports required from Aurelia to Redwood for a hosted demo.
- If you plan to evaluate Private/VPC deployments later, we can share a short network diagram and the minimal CIDR ranges to allow egress to our onboarding servers — happy to attach that.

Action items before Thu:
- Evelyn: send calendar invite + conference bridge
- Me: attach the quick network note and a minimal API sample list to this thread
- Soojin: will add one slide on audit logging and retention policy for the call

I'll attach the sample API list and the brief network note now (stub attachments below).

Cheers,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0112

Attachments: sample-api-endpoints.txt (stub), network-egress-notes.pdf (stub)
